Name: Nic's Kittens
Author: handwrittenhello
Description:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/cK0ySj3p/Stardew-Valley-1-6-15-running-SMAPI-4-2-1-with-18-mods-6-15-2025-3-03-42-AM.png[/img]﻿This mod adds three new colors of kitten you can choose upon starting a new game or which can be adopted from Marnie's ranch upon reaching full hearts with your current pet/reaching year 2 without having a pet.

[size=6]Installation
[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Ensure you have downloaded SMAPI and Content Patcher.
[*]Download the latest version of this mod from here or [url=https://github.com/nbeymer99/CP-Nics-Kittens]Github[/url]﻿.
[*]Unzip the folder into Stardew Valley/Mods. 
[*]Run the game using SMAPI. ﻿
﻿

[/list][size=6]Compatibility
[/size][size=3]
This mod is compatible with mods that add other pets.

Future updates will include new colors/breeds of kitten, including white, orange, tabby, and more.[/size]

Manifest.Name: Nic's Kittens
Manifest.Description: Adds new breeds of kitten available for adoption upon game start or at Marnie's ranch.
Manifest.Author: handwrittenhello
